body_markdown:
This year marks the fifth anniversary of Spotify’s EQUAL, our flagship program dedicated to amplifying women in music through editorial programming, marketing campaigns, and cultural activations. As part of our


[ongoing celebration](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-03-19/equal-the-podcast-5-year-anniversary/) , we’re launching a limited Spotify Singles series honoring the influence, creativity, and legacy of women artists.


The collection brings together five rising stars from around the world, each reimagining an iconic song by a legendary woman artist. Participants include Sweden’s


[Namasenda](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5T68nryXXOMNE2kVe61fKX?si=8d0e9d389c0442bd&nd=1&dlsi=a9df969f6ca44097) , Germany’s


[badmómzjay](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7oWrEQO1d3klp0Qrfh7a5h?si=02285c4c02a044f5&nd=1&dlsi=ebd677ce794246f8) , Portugal’s


[MARO](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3NP4jJcW3R6qO6rbtnH0wn?si=168532e02c7b4d63) , the U.S.’s


[Willow Avalon](https://open.spotify.com/artist/6EEkobfnenJF603WO8nUrR?si=WhRgdHOfTjC6P1_8mvkxzw) , and South Africa’s


[Shekhinah](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1F42GOcKAImOu4yj1b04NB?si=pzRfIl9XSISlcdHTZTw90g) .


“Music has the power to connect cultures, generations, and communities, and we’re proud to play a role in amplifying exceptional women artists across borders,” said


**Bel Aztiria** , Global Music Program Lead at Spotify. “Our new Spotify Singles celebrate both the artists shaping music today and the trailblazing women who paved the way for them, demonstrating the lasting impact women continue to have on music around the world.”


Check out the new Spotify Singles below and hear what each song means to the artists behind them.


## **Namasenda – “Lucky” by Britney Spears**


For Namasenda, recording


[Britney Spears](https://open.spotify.com/artist/26dSoYclwsYLMAKD3tpOr4) ‘ “


[Lucky](https://open.spotify.com/track/2TTYIwTM2iLC1YOyHuhRMt?autoplay_ok=1) ” was a full-circle moment. She first referenced the song in her 2021 track “


[☆ (feat. Oklou)](https://open.spotify.com/track/2RKVFFH9h2vglxvqpN9Xre?si=2fd2d1556b9447bb) ” before performing her own take at the 2025 Denniz Pop Awards, an annual event that honors artists who are contributing to Sweden’s international pop legacy.


“For me, ‘Lucky’ has always been one of the most powerful pop ballads ever written,” she said. “It balances glitter and sorrow in a way I try to do in my own music. Being able to record my own version—and having that happen as part of celebrating EQUAL and women in music—feels extra special.”


Originally from southern Sweden, Namasenda has become one of pop’s most inventive voices. Her latest album,


[Limbo](https://open.spotify.com/album/48BdQtxbatDILuuDZTKDDd) , reflects her mix of experimentation and emotional honesty.


## **badmómzjay – “Rehab” by Rihanna**


[Rihanna](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5pKCCKE2ajJHZ9KAiaK11H) ‘s hit “


[Rehab](https://open.spotify.com/track/5X3ahLXhOw16BR09GjYPUT) ” is a fitting track for badmómzjay, whose genre-defying sound blends confidence with vulnerability in songs about identity and self-acceptance.


“I chose ‘Rehab’ because it’s about a woman taking her power back


and refusing to let love break her down again, and choosing herself instead,”


badmómzjay said. “That’s the energy I want every woman listening to feel. You


don’t need anyone to save you, you can heal yourself and come out stronger.


Still, I truly believe in love, and honestly, I feel this song so deeply. Huge respect to Rihanna for creating something so powerful.”


badmómzjay’s upcoming third studio album,


*Haus im Meer* , is set to be her most personal project to date. Fans in Germany can catch her live when she goes on tour this autumn.


## **MARO – “Sauvignon Blanc” by ROSALÍA**


In her cover, MARO reimagines


[ROSALÍA](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7ltDVBr6mKbRvohxheJ9h1) ‘s “


[Sauvignon Blanc](https://open.spotify.com/track/5QAgAknbr8nCAyAubKsrfS) ” through her own unique lens while paying homage to their shared roots.


“I chose to record ‘Sauvignon Blanc’ because it’s such a beautiful song, and because ROSALÍA is such an inspiring artist,” MARO said. “It also felt like a meaningful choice to record a song by a Spanish artist, given the many cultural and musical links between Portugal and Spain. This felt like a lovely way to celebrate that Iberian connection.”


The singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist has built a devoted fanbase through songs that blend folk, pop, and jazz influences across her collaborations and solo work.


## **Willow Avalon – “You’re So Vain” by Carly Simon**


Willow puts her own rebellious spin on


[Carly Simon](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4FtSnMlCVxCswABUmdhwpm) ‘s classic “


[You’re So Vain](https://open.spotify.com/track/2DnJjbjNTV9Nd5NOa1KGba) ,” paying tribute to one of music’s most celebrated storytellers.


“I chose ‘You’re So Vain’ because it’s a sassy song I grew up on that made me want to write sassy songs,” said Willow. “While I may write songs in a different genre than Carly Simon, the tone is still the same.”


The Georgia native taught herself guitar at 12 and has since become a powerful voice in Nashville’s music scene, taking her sound from the Grand Ole Opry to festival stages. With two albums under her belt—


[Southern Belle Raisin’ Hell](https://open.spotify.com/album/1WYlyS9peUWJQTbUnFyqRD) and


[Pink Pocket Pistol](https://open.spotify.com/album/4YZryAHr8tsQ73nVV0V81v) —Willow continues to build a loyal fanbase.


## **Shekhinah – “I Love Music” by Lebo Mathosa** ****


Shekhinah’s reimagining of “


[I Love Music](https://open.spotify.com/track/7upnrkKxLdS8MshYlvWJQe) ” by


[Lebo Mathosa](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1Ml1ICUucZgJMx8Y4t9aJo) brings her signature blend of pop, R&B, and soul to a song that celebrates joy, creativity, and the transformative power of music.


“Lebo Mathosa is one of the artists who helped shape what it means to be a powerful woman performer in South Africa,” Shekhinah


said


**.** “Recording ‘I Love Music’ felt like a chance to celebrate her legacy while paying tribute to the women who continue to inspire and open doors for the next generation.”


Born in Durban, South Africa, Shekhinah’s platinum-certified debut album


[Rose Gold](https://open.spotify.com/album/0iGhXnhrNFxaSnZN0CK6ML) put her on the country’s pop radar. She’s continued her evolution as an artist with recent albums


[Trouble In Paradise](https://open.spotify.com/album/1ltjerRedPrqqpM0Nb1MXl) ,


[Less Trouble](https://open.spotify.com/album/0Hz8dMfievPvgDBKII1Kgp) , and her newest EP


[Love on Repeat Vol. 1](https://open.spotify.com/album/1QytBHAmYcTRZrux6VKWoU) .


As EQUAL enters its fifth year, the Spotify Singles series is a celebration of how far the program—and the artists it champions—have come. Women have always shaped music, and our EQUAL program is helping make sure their voices are heard around the world, today and for years to come.


*Celebrate EQUAL’s five-year anniversary by checking out the*[EQUAL hub](https://open.spotify.com/genre/0JQ5DAqbMKFPw634sFwguI) *, where you can explore more work from women creators around the world.*
